title: T-011 Wonder Woman staging access audit
summary: Wonder Woman has an isolated staging account, clone, and sanitized database copy. Private app repository access and verified board write access are still missing.
evidence: PASS: Wonder Woman signs in to staging with a dedicated key. Password and root login are disabled.
PASS: Wonder Woman has no administrative privileges.
PASS: Wonder Woman's local application clone is on the assigned access-scale branch. The server, database, interface, and access-control files are present.

PASS: Wonder Woman's sanitized database copy is readable only by Wonder Woman. It matches the canonical checksum, holds 26,559 content chunks, and has no users, questions, feedback, testers, clicks, or referral contact details.
PASS: No production credential, known host, or SSH route exists in Wonder Woman's profile.
FAIL: Wonder Woman has no credential for the private application repository.
FAIL: The board write key is registered but is not installed on the staging host. It has not been verified from Wonder Woman's own session.
FAIL: The board write key has repository-wide scope and cannot be limited to Wonder Woman's branch.
limitations: This is a host-side audit by the orchestrator account. Wonder Woman has not yet run a self-test from Wonder Woman's own session. No changes were made.
